N1.s: Kõik %lld tasuta cutlingit on kasutatud. Jätkake Cutlingis ja avage täisversioon, siis salvestub ka see.
N1.back: All 5 free cutling(partitive) are used. Continue(you-formal) Cutling-in and unlock(you-formal) full-version, then saves-itself also this.
N1.why: 'Jätka' is the vocabulary's continue word, matching the system's continue button; 'täisversioon' is the unlocked app's one name (S23, M1); 'ka see' says this one joins the five. 101 characters.

N2.s: Kõik %lld tasuta cutlingit on kasutatud. Et rohkem salvestada, avage Cutlingis täisversioon.
N2.back: All 5 free cutling(partitive) are used. In-order-to more to-save, unlock(you-formal) Cutling-in full-version.
N2.why: Same first sentence as N1 so Siri says the limit one way; an 'et' clause in front gives the purpose with a verb instead of 'salvestamiseks'. 89 characters.

N3.why: 'Koht' is the slot as in K1; 'vaba koht' (an open place, as on a booking) fits 30 characters where 'tasuta koht' would not, and verb-first 'Jäi üks…' is how Estonian says what is left. No final period, like K1. 30 characters.

N4.why: '5/5 salvestatud' reads as five of five saved, so it says both that this one went in and the count; 'kohad on täis' is the plain booking phrase and picks up N3's 'koht'. 30 characters.

N5.s: %1$lld/%2$lld täis. Avage kõik ja see salvestub
N5.back: 5/5 full. Unlock(you-formal) all and this saves-itself
N5.why: 'Avage kõik' is K1's call and the sheet's button; 'salvestub' (gets saved on its own) is everyday Estonian UI and tells the person the item is not lost. 37 characters.

N6.why: The sheet's own button without the price (S15), singular imperative as Apple's buttons are, so the action has one name in every place. 8 characters.

N7.s: Kõik %lld tasuta cutlingit on kasutatud. Avage kõik, siis salvestub ka see.
N7.back: All 5 free cutling(partitive) are used. Unlock(you-formal) all, then saves-itself also this.
N7.why: Names the 'Ava kõik' button beside it rather than 'täisversioon', so the notice and the button say the same verb; same closing clause as N1. 72 characters.

N8.s: See cutling on teie jaoks hoiul. Avage Cutlingis täisversioon ja see salvestub.
N8.back: This cutling is you(formal) for in-safekeeping. Unlock(you-formal) Cutling-in full-version and it saves-itself.
N8.why: 'Hoiul' is the word for something held safe for someone, without an app 'we'; Cutling is named because the button here could not open it, and 'see' points back to the cutling, the sentence's topic. 79 characters.
